paper.title: Enhancing Affine Maximizer Auctions with Correlation-Aware Payment

claims.paper_claim: Deterministic AMA can be arbitrarily poor
claims.scope: The n=1 posted-price counterexample contradicts the printed any-n quantifier; high-precision n>=2 certificates support the intended construction.
Intended multi-bidder identities pass, but one bidder has no rival profile and cannot realize correlated separation.
Symbolic cancellation and exhaustive finite checks pass for 2–4 bidders and 1–3 items; own-report-dependent payment is a rejected negative control.
Seed-1 AMenuNet evidence is close and the five-seed pCor proxy passes bounded checks, but exact_released_2048_menu_core_available is false.
Source/data mismatch, undertrained pilots, direct mechanism pilot, and exact welfare/IR audit do not supply a paper-faithful verdict or valid falsification.

limitations: The previous live judge score of 3/10 is historical provenance only.
C4 lacks the exact released five-seed 2048-menu core.
C5 remains blocked by public source/data contract and optimization limitations.
No current score or author endorsement is claimed.
